summary: This experimental document proposes raising TCP's permitted initial window from between 2 and 4 segments to 10 segments, falling back to the older recommendation if problems appear. It explains the motivation, weighs the pros and cons, and reports large-scale experiments in which the larger window improved performance for many web services.

eli5.summary: When two computers start talking, TCP lets only a few packets go out first. This tries letting more go at once so pages load faster, backing off if the road gets crowded.
